sources.detail: All 6 pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by direct curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB each. Parsed <table class="tier-list"> rows (leading <td> = tier letter; tier-list-entry img alt = "Spec Class" resolved against the exact roster; spell-icon alts inside the details blocks are correctly ignored). 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec exactly once per page. Era-verified per <title>: "Midnight (12.0.7)" / "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" / "Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1"; the 3-4 "Season 2" hits per page are dated 2023/2025 CHANGELOG entries (Dragonflight and TWW), not this season. Devourer present in both DPS lists (raid A+, M+ S). 0 tier moves vs committed. Snapshots 07-30 -> 07-31.

Both pages fetched live by direct curl, HTTP 200 (152 KB raid / 164 KB M+). Parsed the tier__tier blocks (tier__title letter + data-original-title spec names, each block bounded at the next tier__tier or tierlist-nav marker). Era-verified: raid body reads "Midnight Season 1 Raids: The Voidspire, The Dreamrift and March on Quel Danas", M+ body reads Season 1; 0 "Season 2" hits on either page this run (the stale TWW-Season-3 meta tags noted on 07-30 are not present in this fetch). Raid 39 rows (Vengeance DH still omitted upstream, a longstanding absence) + M+ 40 = 79, 0 unmatched; the 8 rejected strings on the M+ page are the dungeon tier list, correctly excluded. 0 tier moves.

All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 80-315 KB, via the transport the 07-30 run identified: direct curl carrying the full browser header set (Accept, Accept-Language, sec-ch-ua*, sec-fetch-*, upgrade-insecure-requests). Parsed the [tier-list=rows] block inside the WH.markup.printHtml payload. NEW PARSER NOTE worth carrying forward: inside that payload the markup is JSON-ESCAPED, so the closing tags read [\/tier-label] and a literal search for "[tier-list]" finds nothing — unescape \/ to / before matching, then read [tier-label bg=qN]X[/tier-label] + [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] slugs. 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, M+ DPS A+ tier present. Era-verified: every <title> reads "for Midnight Season 1". 0 tier moves. Note the raid DPS S tier is genuinely EMPTY upstream (its [tier-content] block has no entries) — the same shape as committed, not a parse loss.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from __NEXT_DATA__ specTierListSection.tierLists (raid = throughput tierList, M+ = score), resolving each entry from its icon "Class-Spec" token. 80 rows, 0 unmatched. Archon HAS re-aggregated since the last run: lastUpdated advanced 2026-07-29T12:00:00Z -> 2026-07-30T12:00:00Z on all 6 pages, and 4 raid tier moves followed, every one exactly ONE band: Havoc DH A->S, Frost Mage A->S, Unholy DK B->A, Demonology Warlock B->A. M+ 0 moves. Titles still read "Midnight ... VS / DR / MQD Tier List" (Season 1 raids), no Season 2. Total parses 436662 raid DPS / 2594699 M+ DPS.

Full re-fetch of all 9 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 and every encounter parsing a complete 40/40 specs, so nothing was written from a partial page (the script refuses to write an encounter with <40 specs). 680 tier cells, 35 changed, tracking the same 07-29 -> 07-30 Archon re-aggregation as the aggregate pages. Encounter slugs match the stored keys exactly; no new or retired encounters. encounter-tiers.json asOf 07-30 -> 07-31, written in place so key order is preserved and the diff shows only real cell changes.

Survivability tierList re-parsed from all 3 raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 rows, merged via the apply-metrics survivability key. 13 cells moved, all exactly one band and all downward (6 A->B: Destruction, Devastation, Subtlety, Arms, Affliction, Survival; 7 B->C: Arcane, Fury, Shadow, Retribution, Demonology, Feral, Balance) — consistent with the 07-29 -> 07-30 re-aggregation that also moved the throughput tiers, parsed from the same tierLists array with the same code path.

Re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList): "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" = 33 rows (27 raid DPS + 6 tanks; healer pages also expose a dps column but healer damage stays deliberately excluded, matching the committed series shape), each carrying n = the row parses count, values rounded to integers (the raw field is a float). Values moved with the 07-30 aggregate; largest single-row move across the whole Archon numeric set was 4.84%, well inside the value-move guard. 33 rows against a floor of 25.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses, values rounded. Moved with the 07-30 Archon re-aggregation. 7 rows against a floor of 5.
"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages specRankingsSection score column = 40/40 specs with n = parses. Moved with the 07-30 Archon re-aggregation. 40 rows against a floor of 25.

HEALTHY AGAIN — the three-night raid-half corruption is gone from committed data (the 07-30 LOCAL run landed the de-corrupted series) and this run simply refreshed it normally. 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100 and merged with no hold-back. Sanity-checked the shape that caught the corruption last time: every value is a plausible percentage (raid range 0.5-28.7, M+ likewise), none carries a DPS magnitude, and no row equals its spec 95th-pct DPS value. 80 rows against a floor of 60.

3 M+ pages by DIRECT fetch (SvelteKit SSRs the tier data; the r.jina.ai proxy is not needed). Parsed the alt="X tier" headers, segmenting each tier at the next header or and keeping the first occurrence per spec after stripping the trailing " Icon" from alt=" Icon". 40/40 specs across S/A/B/C/D, 0 unmatched, 0 tier moves. Era-verified "[MN 12.0.7]" in every title plus a "Mythic+ Season 1" badge and 0 "Season 2" hits. The 3 raid pages were re-fetched and remain unranked upstream (a single "X tier" header, "Unranked", "0 records", no spec rows), so their snapshots stay null by design.

PARSER NOTE: segment the document between consecutive class="...meta-item" anchors and read each block img alt="<Spec> <Class> Icon" plus the first number after its </svg> — pairing on the .h3 name blocks inside a fixed-size window silently yielded only 28/40. Still weekly period 1074 (MID1; Lindormi Guidance, Xal atath Bargain: Devour, Fortified, Tyrannical, Xal atath Guile) but the period IS still filling and the counters moved: top 2000 keys / 10000 characters (5080 unique) / 21.3 average key level, up from 9999 / 6607 unique / 19.1. 39 of 40 specs charted and merged, 38 values changed. THE ONE ABSENCE IS UPSTREAM, NOT A PARSE ERROR: Devastation Evoker has no bar and no image on the chart this period (0 occurrences of "devastation" anywhere in the page) — it has fallen out of the top-2000-key population entirely. Writing a 0 would be an inference, so its stored 2026-07-30 row was left untouched; the family therefore holds 40 rows of which 39 are fresh, and coverage (floor 25) is 2026-07-31. No season flip.
